title: Menger Curve and Non-Planar Boundaries in Quotients of Hyperbolic Groups
summary: We study the persistence of non-planarity in boundaries of hyperbolic groups under quotients, focusing on quotients by large enough powers of infinite order elements. We prove that the non-planarity of the boundary of a one-ended hyperbolic group is preserved under such quotients. As a consequence, we obtain an analogous result about the persistence of Menger curve boundaries.
